programme.desc: The Wattersons try and reconnect Darwin to his fish roots.

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball - Season 1
programme.desc: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone’s entire face is in the photo and they’re all smiling.

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball - Season 1
programme.desc: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom And Jerry take their chase to the skies. Kite-flying has never been this intense. Who will emerge as the ultimate master of strings?

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mishmosh’s new de-aging device causes trouble when it accidentally zaps Miss Petunia and Old Coot into their younger selves. But Moley soon discovers that the de-aging doesn’t stop and he and his friends must rescue them before it’s too late.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and Dotty go on a wild adventure after getting transformed into worms, only to discover that Squirm comes from a whole new alien world that has been under MoleTown the entire time!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mishmosh falls ill and is unable to compete in MoleTown’s greatest inventor competition, Moley and Dotty must dress up and compete in his place against other great Mole inventors!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the anniversary of Moley becoming the keeper of Manny, and Dotty, with a little help from her Uncle Mishmosh, goes back in time to see what she had missed before she came to MoleTown.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Dotty, now stuck in the past and with nobody recognising her, goes to her uncle for help and they must work together to bring her back to present-day MoleTown without interfering with the past.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: When Chanterelle comes across something Mush-Mush has made, she declares him a genius artist! But Mush-Mush is not sure that’s the kind of genius he wants to be.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: So Bolly can take a break and head off to have fun, our Mushlers insist that they will do all the repairs around Mushton for him. Now Bolly needs to fix all their repairs!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Everyone realizes that they don’t actually know what Fung and Miff’s special gifts are! So Puff and our Mushlers set out to try and find out without Fung and Miff knowing.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep has created a cloak out of a leaf and Chanterelle thinks it’s super fashionable. But when she makes a similar cloak to Chep’s, a fashion rivalry is born!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: To finally bring life-long friends Mushpot and Starmush back together, Truff goes to help Starmush succeed at an impossible challenge set by Musho…

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom and Multy are sent to train with a Legendary SuperThing, Lancelord.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: Hildie sends Tom and Jerry into the woods to find a baby dragon who they befriend on their way home. But when Hildie tells them she plans on making the dragon into dinner, Tom and Jerry work together to save him.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: It's Spike's birthday and he has been counting the days down. Every year, Rick goes all out to make it special, but not this one. He has forgotten! Seeing how sad Spike is, Tom and Jerry work together to give the pooch a birthday to remember. Unfortunately, their every effort backfires -- but don't worry, it ends happily.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 1
programme.desc: Butch tricks Tom into switching places with him and sends Tom off to live the life of a street cat.Butch finds out that living Tom's cushy life isn't what it seems when Jerry makes his life difficult and Ginger's doting is humiliating. Tom finds that living off the street is tricky and difficult. They very quickly switch back to the way it was.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 1
programme.desc: Tuffy hires detectives Tom and Jerry to investigate the ghost hauntings in his house. At first Tom and Jerry think it's just his imagination but discover that the house seems haunted. They find out it's a rat who wanted to chase Tuffy out so he could live there with his family but is ok with sharing the home.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Batwing and Goldie secretly decide to participate in the Gotham Air-Show, but when Batman needs their help, they must choose between winning the competition and their responsibilities to fight crime.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He’s too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city shaking shenanigans.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are herding a massive pack of pachycephalosaurs! The stubborn herd keeps scattering in every direction! High above, Miguel spots danger ahead, a tiny psittacosaurus right in the herd’s path! Miguel swoops down and plucks the little dino out of harm’s way, but the pint-sized creature unleashes a squawk so loud it rattles the trees, sending the baby dino tumbling into the jungle below!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During an underwater patrol, the Ranchers spot Shelly, their young sea turtle friend. But Shelly urges the team to follow her into the depths, straight to a weakened Mama Turtle! Min quickly diagnoses the problem: shell shingles!t Uncle Jack delivers bad news, they’re short on Blue Sea Kelp, the only remedy! Jon and Miguel, ever the eager “bro-moms,” volunteer to go fetch it!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wakes up on a freezing cold winter’s morning to discover that the boiler is broken and no sign of the repairman. He tries increasingly ridiculous ways to warm up his tea his toothpaste and himself before venturing out to discover somewhere to hunker down and get warm.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Irma wants a romantic break; Bean doesn’t. It’s too expensive. Irma kidnaps Teddy and refuses to give him back unless Bean promises to take her to Paris. Caught between his inability to pay and his love of Teddy Bean doesn’t know what to do! Until he spots a cat beauty competition in which first prize is a romantic break in Paris – if only he can catch Scrapper …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Bean wants to avoid lunch with Irma’s Mum at all costs. He persuades Mrs. Wicket to let him join her on a coach trip to a concert – but he has to disguise himself as an old-aged pensioner or he won’t be allowed on the coach. Once on the coach Bean drives everyone mad with his anti-boredom antics.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Unhappy about a mystery-free, three-day, cross-country train trip with the gang, Fred is pleasantly surprised to discover a monster mystery on board. He's less pleasantly surprised however, when that mystery is interrupted by a second mystery, then a third, then a fourth…

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: On a trip to Japan to visit Velma's friend, the gang comes face to face with the ancient crab monster, Kaniaku, and attempts to solve a 700 year-old mystery. Meanwhile, Daphne accidentally becomes a viral media sensation in Japan!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy is about to go to bed, he ousts the Lemmings who are holding a surprise party in the cabin. The Lemmings land in a Mayan Temple devoted to the moon. While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy does his best to get rid of the Lemmings and enjoy some peace and quiet in the cabin, but each time they come back with a new and even more-disturbing activity. When he sees some penguins marching in a perfectly disciplined line, Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence. He locks himself up with them inside the garage, which has been transformed into an elementary school classroom. Grizzy is determined to make discipline reign but he has forgotten about the Lemming’s natural penchant for bedlam.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight once again and cause an accident with Santa Claus’ sled. The Lemmings rush to the crash site and get their hands on Santa’s magic bag. While Grizzy is tidying up the cabin after their fight, he is baffled to see the Lemmings come back him, quiet and calm. The rodents break out into Christmas carols and prepare a delicious snack for Grizzy before slipping out again. Suspicious, Grizzy follows them and discovers that the bag rewards persons whose wishes are equal to their goodwill.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings do not agree on which program to watch on TV. Grizzy confiscates the remote-control device. He thinks he’s won the battle, but the Lemmings find another one at the research station. A furious combat begins until the adversaries realize that the research station device has a special button that controls objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a blast racing down the ice slope in competition with the stuffed Bear-Ranger and manage to win each time. Grizzy cannot stand seeing his avatar humiliated and he decides to enter the competition to help him. Their frenzied descent gets out of hand and everyone is propelled all the way to the hangar of the research station, where they discover an ultra-sophisticated racing game. The racecourse sprawls over the entire icefield via drones that project holographic elements. Grizzy and the Lemmings get into super-fast snowmobiles and launch into the race of the century.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings shave ice from the icefield and whip it into granita, but the result is flavorless. He decides to make granita in an empty jar of Yummy so that the chocolate left over on the sides of the jar will flavor the dessert. It’s delicious! The Lemmings, who consider it was their recipe, swap the chocolate granita with another one made in an old flowerpot with potting soil. The choco-granito race is off and running!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are starving for their reserves are depleted and their fishing has been unsuccessful. Fortunately, a truck delivers a crate of edibles to the research station that contains compact food cubes. When placed under a special light beam, the cubes retransform into delicious meals. Grizzy discovers that the decompressing lamp can, conversely, compact organic elements too. For example, the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings pace around the log cabin searching for virtual animals to capture with their tablet game. Annoyed by their behavior, Grizzy throws them outside. Determined to continue playing, the Lemmings trick the bear. But when the tablet hits the circuit breaker and explodes, the gaming animals come to life! Ice dinosaurs, laser caribous and giant carnivorous plants. The life-size hunt can begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput shows kindness to a nearby spider - and in the process makes a valuable ally. Good thing, too, because the mozzies around here are diabolical.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: Tom's being unusually difficult when he's rocked by an epiphany-- HE'S LOSING HIS HAIR! Paranoid that he's going to become a hairless cat, Tom will do anything Jerry tells him to do in order to regrow it. Think mud packs (more like mud slaps), hair transfers (one word – furballs) deep tissue massage to stimulate follicle development (a.k.a repeated blows to the head), and skunk therapy ('nuf said). Most everything he tries only leads to Ginger throwing him in the bath again. Ultimately, Tom realizes that Jerry's spiking his cat shampoo with hair remover and it's about to get hairy for the mouse!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: When Tom's hit by a trolley while he and Jerry are investigating their latest case, he's sent to recover at the local animal hospital. But a detective is never off the case! Tom begins to suspect the answer to the case they're working on is right under his broken nose. Problem is, he's in traction and can't move. That's okay, he's got a partner in crime-solving – Doc Jerry makes the rounds at the animal hospital and solves the mystery, but not before sending Tom on the rounds to endure various tests (e.g. x-rays, stress test, physical therapy, etc…) and to do some investigating of his own.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: When a little cat and mouse ends poorly for Tom, he ends up having to wear the cone of shame.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: A little cat and mouse leads Jerry to take refuge in his hole in the wall where he runs into Franky Two-Face the rat, who now calls Jerry's home, HIS home. Tom finds this funny, of course. Franky Two-Face leads Tom to believe the two are working together but Franky's a no-good, dirty rat. He doesn't play fair. He's a liar, a sneak, a dirty player, just an all-around dirty rat. He goes to the cats in the alley, says Jerry thinks they're soft, steals things from Spike and sets Tom up as the thief. Franky Two-Face knows every dirty trick in the book, except one; the one Tom and Jerry use to get rid of Franky Two-Face.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: After another destructive bout of cat and mouse, Hildie and Beatie decide that Tom's bad cat-titude has caused nothing but trouble around the cottage. What Tom needs is an attitude adjustment! With a flick of the wand, Tom becomes a doting cat. Much better! Jerry's loving the change at first, but he soon tires of the touchy-feely feline (even Newt is tiring of Tom's affections). Jerry tries every mouse trick in the book to trigger Tom's animal instincts, but nothing seems to break the spell. Jerry has to sneak Hildie's wand to reverse the spell, but it won't be easy with tag-along-Tom by his side every step of the way!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: When Tom ends up on the losing end of a little cat and mouse AGAIN Butch sends in Meathead, a pinch hitter, to deal with Jerry. Surprisingly, Meathead has no trouble catching the little mouse. There's nothing Tom or Jerry can do to make it harder. Jerry's superior intelligence is no match for Meathead's dumb luck.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Bean discovers Declan giving Irma a lift in his swanky new SUV. Bean is unimpressed until Declan shows off all the car’s features. Undeterred Bean professes his car superior. Declan issues a challenge – to see which car Irma will choose for her lift back to work. Bean decides his car may need a little ‘pimping’ …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mrs. Wicket’s Nephew is staying with her when he wins two tickets to an Outward Bound course. She refuses to go but then ropes in Bean to look after the child. The two start a competition to see who will win the trophy. Bean is a relentless competitor winning everything up until the point things start getting out of hand …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself dogged by a young Japanese boy at the Science Museum. He takes an instant dislike to the Scallywag until he sees what the kid has in his backpack: gadgets so cool you can’t even get them in the West. So when a security guard tries to ruin their fun they run away together to... Mars!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After the Joker floods the Batcave, the Batwheels evacuate and relocate to a nearby parking garage. As they adapt to their temporary home, they learn important lessons about family and making the most of what you have.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Batman refuses to engage Joker in a race, Prank goads Bam into a rematch. Can Bam learn to not give in to the bully's dares and take the high road?

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: A musical tribute to Ace, the super-brave bat-hound!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: You never can tell when inspiration’s gonna strike. Specs and Skinny are having a nice evening at the theatre, enjoying a magic show, when the perfect Lamput-catching strategy falls right in their lap! “The perfect strategy” is a magic necklace of invisibility. “Falling in their lap” is stealing it from the magician’s dressing room. Specs and Skinny waste no time tracking Lamput down and ruining a perfectly good picnic. As usual the Docs snatch defeat from the jaws of victory when Lamput gets a hold of the necklace. Now the orange blob can morph AND go invisible. No fair!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy pinches a magic statue from the Lemmings that has the power to make objects appear in real life. All you have to do, is pin the photo of one's desires upon it. Too bad for the rodents' snow-bike! Grizzy replaces the vehicle's photo with the portrait of his beloved she-bear who stayed behind in Canada. Barely arrived in African, the she-bear disappears again, victim of the rodents' trickery. It is the outbreak of a bitter dispute.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Annoyed by the Lemmings' new magnetic train, Grizzy propels the whole lot of them far from the cabin. The rodents land in the neighboring hut of a sorcerer and a mysterious mask falls onto one of them, endowing him with the power of telekinesis. The Lemmings are thrilled! They return to the cabin to explore this new magic power. Perched upon pieces of furniture, they fly around the room to finish their life-size flying train game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy chases after the Lemmings, who have loaded a jar of Yummy into their remote-control driven car. Where the bear gets to the gas station, he destroys the vehicle and recovers the chocolate spread. The rodents find little mini-cars and chase Grizzy all the way back to the cabin, where they trip him up and intercept the coveted jar. Helpless, the bear sets out after them, until he runs into a tank truck filled with Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Ledynmetis. Susidūrimas
programme.desc: Išdykęs voveriukas Skretas ir vėl pridarys bėdų. Savo išsvajotą gilę jis randa įšalusioje skraidančioje lėkštėje ir bandydamas ją ištraukti iš ledo pajudina svirtį bei netikėtai išskrenda į kosmosą. Ten Skretas vėl neapsieina be nuotykių – prisidirba tiek, kad Žemės link pažyra daugybė meteorų. Šios „krentančios žvaigždės“ Žemėje gyvenantiems gyvūnams laimės neatneš. Jie turės kuo skubiau ieškoti, kur pasislėpti. Per mamutų Menio ir Elės vestuvių metines meteorai įbaugina susirinkusius svečius, tampa aišku, kad romantikos čia nebus, nors vestuvėms ruošiasi ir jų dukra, apie šeimos pagausėjimą galvoja Diegas, tik Sidas jaučiasi vienišas. Tad saugodami savo gyvybes Menis, Elė, Sidas, Diegas ir kiti palieka namus ir leidžiasi į ilgą kelionę, kurioje bus pavojų, rizikos, tačiau netrūks ir juoko, atradimų bei naujų, spalvingų draugų!

programme.title: Dėl visko kalta meilė

Vieną dieną gražios jaunos kaimynės užkluptas sėdintis savo mirusios mamos invalido vežimėlyje, Žoslenas (vaidina Franck Dubosc) sukurpia istoriją apie savo tariamą traumą, vien tik tam, kad suviliotų savo patraukliąją kaimynę – slaugę. Tačiau šioji mergišių supažindina su savo simpatiškąja neįgalia seserimi, orkestro smuikininke (Alexandra Lamy), kuri Žosleną netikėtai iš tiesų sužavi. Vyriškį užvaldo iki tol dar nepažinti jausmai, jis nebežino kaip išsisukti iš painios situacijos, kur susipynė melas ir meilė.Franck Dubosc yra ne tik filmo „Dėl visko kalta meilė“ režisierius bei pagrindinės rolės atlikėjas, bet ir scenarijaus autorius, kruopščiai pasirūpinęs kiekviena detale filme, kiekviena scena.

Viena iš jų yra kiaulė Rosita, namuose vaikus auginanti mama, paaukojusi savo jaunystės svajonę tapti dainininke. Konkursu ir didžiuliu piniginiu prizu susidomėjo ir smulkiu sukčiavimu besiverčiantis pelėnas, nuo žiaurios scenos baimės kenčianti dramblė, jaunas gorila iš nusikaltėlių giminės ir pankuojanti dygliakiaulė. programme.title: Šokis svajonės ritmu 2
programme.desc: Niujorkas – svajonių miestas visiems, siekiantiems sužibėti. Talentinga balerina Barlau nutaria išbandyti save naujo Brodvėjaus šokio spektaklio atrankoje. Režisierius pastebi ją ir priima į trupę. Netrukus prie repeticijų prisijungia ir pianistas Čarlis. Tarp Barlau ir Čarlio užsimezga simpatija. Jaunuolių jausmai nelieka nepastebėti. Spektaklio režisierius Zanderis taip pat jaučia trauką gražuolei Barlau. Meilės trikampyje atsidūrusi balerina blaškosi ir nežino, kaip pasielgti teisingai. Darbas iki devinto prakaito, nuolatinis stresas, varžovų išdavystės ir vis artėjanti svajonė sužibėti didžiojoje scenoje.

programme.title: Ričis Didysis
programme.desc: Vos išsiritęs iš kiaušinio paukštelis Ričis tryško gyvenimo džiaugsmu – jis trokšta skraidyti ir pamatyti pasaulį. Vargšelis ne iš karto pamatė, kad skiriasi nuo savo tėvų. Tėvai gandrai priglaudė Ričio kiaušinį, kuris iš tikrųjų buvo žvirblio. Jis, deja, dydžiu nė negali lygintis su savo netikrais tėvais. Artėja žiema ir gandrai išskleidžia sparnus kelionei į Afriką, Ričis, kadangi yra žvirblis, turi likti žiemoti, bet jis irgi nori skristi į pietus! Tokia kelionė labai pavojinga, tačiau kai susirandi ištikimų draugų, viskas yra įmanoma! Ar šiam žaviam žvirbliukui pavyks įrodyti, kad jo mažame kūne plaka didelio gandro širdis?

programme.title: Vienas namuose 5. Šventinis apiplėšimas
programme.desc: Kai Baksterių šeima persikelia į naują namą kitoje valstijoje, dešimtmetis Finas baiminasi, kad jų name vaidenasi. Kol jis spendžia spąstus „vaiduokliui“ sugauti, jo tėvai įstringa mieste, ir Finas su sesute lieka namuose vieni. Tuo metu vagių trijulė ieško brangaus paveikslo, kurį slaptame kambaryje paslėpė ankstesnis savininkas. Tačiau ar jiems pavyks gauti tai, ko nori ir laimėti mūšį su genialiu vaiku?

Nors Blu stengiasi pritapti prie naujų kaimynų, jis jaudinasi, kad gali netekti Džuel ir vaikų šiame gamtos prieglobstyje.

programme.title: Robocar Poli
programme.desc: In Brooms Town, a small town with a strong rescue team, there are always accidents and troubles such as a car sliding off a cliff in the rain, a car crash, a child locked in a firehouse, and so on. In every episode, the town's rescue team saves characters.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Talking Tom and his friends - Angela, Ben and Hank discover a mysterious device that grants them amazing powers and makes them “Suddenly Super”! Now they’re amped up with awesome abilities and an assortment of gotta-have-it gadgets and ready to defend their city from all kinds of disasters and villains, with some backup from their reliable friends, Talking Becca and Talking Ginger.Unfortunately, it turns out there is no instruction manual for being a superhero and together they will have to discover their real powers and save the day!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Rainbow Ruby is the story of a spunky, resourceful little girl who magically transports to Rainbow Village, a whimsical land inhabited by her toys, and transforms into different jobs to help save the day!

programme.title: Matchbox Adventures
programme.desc: Get ready to Drive Your Adventure and join Mason James and his sister Kayla as they take their Matchbox cars on epic quests and tackle incredible challenges! Watch as the playroom transforms into an erupting volcano, a scorching desert, and even the Everglades – wherever your imagination can take you!

programme.title: Jonny Jetboy
programme.desc: Jonny Jones is the youngest member of The Jones family, who are secretly a family of superheroes known as THE JETFLEET! Like every family, they don’t always get along, but when they work together, nothing in the world can stop them!

programme.title: Dino Dana
programme.desc: Dana on innukas 10-aastane tüdruk, kes armastab dinosauruseid. Kohe nii väga, et isa valmistas talle erilise seljakoti, mille abil ta saab muutuda ükskõik milliseks dinosauruseks. Ees ootavad vägevad dinoseiklused!

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Loomaleksikon
programme.desc: Loomaleksikon viib nii lapsed kui ka pered teekonnale loomamaailma. Ookeani sügavustest kuni Aafrika südameni kohtuvad lapsed huvitavate, ainulaadsete ja põnevate loomadega, tutvudes nende elupaikade, ökosüsteemide, geograafia ja eriliste omadustega.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Teaduspauk

programme.title: Loomade jutud

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused

programme.title: Andy safari seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab Safari maailmas, kogu Maakera kõige suuremas ja paremas looduspargis koos oma ülemuse, härra Hammondi ja tehnikavõluri Jeniga. Mistahes huvitav ülesanne teda ees ka ei ootaks, kihutab Andy oma safari-autoga kohale.

programme.title: Jutuvestjad

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Mavka. Miško siela
programme.desc: Tankiuose miškuose nuo seno gyvena ir gamtos unikalumą saugo daugybė pasakiškų būtybių. Svarbiausią vaidmenį jų tarpe atliekantis miško Sergėtojas yra atsakingas už Gyvybės Medžio išsaugojimą. Šis medis turi ypatingų galių ir tik jis gali suteikti gyvastį visam pasakiškam pasauliui. Pavasario šauklė Mavka pabunda iš gilaus miego ir pradeda budinti miško gamtą. O visai netrukus, geraširdė fėja išrenkama naująja Gyvybės Medžio Sergėtoja.Vieną dieną Mavka visai netoliese išgirsta nuostabią muziką. Kiek pasidairiusi ji pamato žmogų, grojantį medine fleita. Nors miško būtybės privengia žmonių, Mavka įsidrąsinusi prieina prie berniuko. Ji iškart pajunta, kad šio žmogaus širdyje nėra pykčio ir blogio, nes jo visą esybę valdo muzika. Lukas ir Mavka susidraugauja ir, atrodytų, niekas negalėtų aptemdyti nuostabaus jų kartu leidžiamo laiko.Bet nenujausdamas nieko bloga, Lukas patenka į klastingos turtuolės Kylinos pinkles. Sužinojusi, kad berniukas draugauja su fėja, Kylina sukurpia planą, kaip sekdama jį, ji aptiks pasakiškų būtybių buveines ir ras Gyvybės Medį. Juk šis medis gali suteikti amžiną jaunystę, kurios taip trokšta turtuolė. Norėdama suburti kuo didesnę kariauną, Kylina nuteikia kaimo žmones prieš miško būtybes ir, lydima jų, išsiruošia į mišką.Užverda siaubingas mūšis ir dabar Mavka privalės paaukoti viską, kad išsaugotų savo gimtuosius namus, apgintų Gyvybės Medį ir nenužudytų tikėjimo žmonių gerumu.

programme.title: Letenėlės. Privatūs sekliai
programme.desc: Neseniai našliu tapusį privatų detektyvą Konorą Viljamsą pasamdo gražuolė veterinarė. Gydytoja Katerina nori įrodyti, kad jos tetos testamentą neteisėtai užginčijo ir perėmė dėdulė Forestas Vortingtonas. Testamentu palikti pinigai turėjo būti skirti moderniai gyvūnų prieglaudai, tačiau dėdulė juos naudoja ne pagal paskirtį. Ilgainiui pradeda aiškėti, kad jokių įkalčių prieš sukčiaujantį poną Forestą nepavyks rasti ir nuostabios gyvūnų prieglaudos idėja liks neįgyvendinta. Čia į pagalbą tėčiui detektyvui nutaria ateiti Konoro sūnus Piteris. Berniukas su savo augintiniu šuneliu ir kalbančia papūga imasi bylos tyrimo. Sėkmė šypsos ir tik didelio atkaklumo dėka svajonė priartėja. Foresto Vortingtono niekšybės išplaukia į paviršių, o dvaro rekonstrukcija į gyvūnų prieglaudą tampa ranka pasiekiama.

programme.title: Šešėlių žaidimas
programme.desc: Trevisas Blokas yra su savo šešėline praeitimi bandantis susitaikyti vyriausybės darbuotojas. Sužinojęs apie sąmokslą prieš JAV piliečius, jis atsiduria FTB direktoriaus taikiklyje.

programme.title: Sąžiningas vagis
programme.desc: Buvęs JAV jūrų pėstininkas Tomas Dolanas tampa legendiniu bankų plėšiku. Ilgus metus slapstęsis nuo teisėsaugos, vyriškis nutaria pripažinti kaltę ir, mainais už prisipažinimą ir pinigų grąžinimą, kalėti itin trumpą laiką. Visas šis planas gali padėti jam reabilituotis ir ateityje laimingai gyventi su nauja širdies drauge Ane Vilkins. Psichologiją studijuojanti mergina palaiko Tomo planą ir tikisi drauge su juo praleisti visą gyvenimą. Tačiau FTB agentas Semas Beikeris nepasitiki Tomu ir į jo nurodytą pinigų saugojimo vietą išsiunčia du pavaldinius. Nivensas ir Holas, nuvykę į slėptuvę ir pamatę nesuskaičiuojamą galybę grynųjų, surezga suktą planą. Jie nutaria pasisavinti visus pinigus ir galiausiai atsikratyti Tomo. Akistata viešbučio kambaryje baigiasi FTB agento Semo Beikerio mirtimi. Dabar Tomas su Ane privalo kuo greičiau sprukti, nes korumpuoti agentai visą kaltę dėl vadovo mirties suverčia niekuo dėtam Tomui.

programme.title: Sveikatos medis
programme.desc: Televizijos laida „Sveikatos medis“ – tarsi televizinis žurnalas, kurio tikslas – svarbios, naudingos, aktualios ir pačios naujausios medicininės, farmacinės ir sveikatingumo naujienos. Laidą sudaro 4 rubrikos – „Sveikatos naujienos“, „Ačiū, daktare“, „Vaistininkas pataria“ ir „Gyvenkime sveikai“ – tad kas savaitę laidoje bus apžvelgiamas platus temų spektras. Laidos pašnekovai bus ne tik mokslo daktarai, profesoriai ar ministrai, bet ir eiliniai praeiviai gatvėje. Laidos vedėja – daktarė, ilgametė sveikatos laidų vedėja ir kūrėja Irena Pivoriūnienė.

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Maisto tinklaraštininkė, nuomonės formuotoja, knygų autorė Kotryna Starkienė imsis užduoties ruošti patiekalus iš sezoninių produktų, savo sodyboje Dzūkijoje užaugintų daržovių, surinktų uogų, grybų ar iš vietinių augintojų pirktos mėsos. Kotryna gamins tiek kasdienius, kiekvienam lengvai paruošiamus patiekalus, tiek šventinius, skirtus specialioms progoms, nepamiršdama desertų. Laidoje bus ir buitinių patarimų – kaip paprasčiausiai išvalyti skalbimo mašiną, kaip padaryti, kad medinės pjaustymo lentelės vėl atrodytų, kaip naujos, kaip išlyginti staltiesę, kai neturite lygintuvo.

Nors miško būtybės privengia žmonių, Mavka įsidrąsinusi prieina prie berniuko. Ji iškart pajunta, kad šio žmogaus širdyje nėra pykčio ir blogio, nes jo visą esybę valdo muzika. Lukas ir Mavka susidraugauja ir, atrodytų, niekas negalėtų aptemdyti nuostabaus jų kartu leidžiamo laiko.Bet nenujausdamas nieko bloga, Lukas patenka į klastingos turtuolės Kylinos pinkles. Sužinojusi, kad berniukas draugauja su fėja, Kylina sukurpia planą, kaip sekdama jį, ji aptiks pasakiškų būtybių buveines ir ras Gyvybės Medį. Juk šis medis gali suteikti amžiną jaunystę, kurios taip trokšta turtuolė. Norėdama suburti kuo didesnę kariauną, Kylina nuteikia kaimo žmones prieš miško būtybes ir, lydima jų, išsiruošia į mišką.Užverda siaubingas mūšis ir dabar Mavka privalės paaukoti viską, kad išsaugotų savo gimtuosius namus, apgintų Gyvybės Medį ir nenužudytų tikėjimo žmonių gerumu.
